statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete. The requested host redirects through xpvid.cc and vidoy.com to the audited final origin https://vidoy.asia/.

page.framework: Server-rendered HTML with Hotwire Turbo on public pages
page.notes: Public auth, recovery, legal and 404 templates audited. Authenticated dashboard, upload, playback, earnings and account-management pages were not covered because no credentials were supplied; those distinct gated archetypes require a separate authenticated audit.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The first viewport is content-first: brand, concise value proposition, and one auth card without competing navigation or decorative frames.
At 360x800, layout metrics report scrollWidth/clientWidth 360, horizontalOverflowPx 0, and the mobile screenshot shows a single-column form.
The CSS probe finds no @container rules; the auth card is adapted exclusively with max/min-width media queries.
The focus probe reports outline none and no focus box-shadow for the auth tabs, submit button, eye button and Create account action; several footer/action links measure 16px high.
The first viewport states “Make money by sharing videos” and presents Login/Register as the dominant next actions.
Lighthouse captured an uncaught Cloudflare Turnstile Error 110200 while the registration form depends on cf-turnstile-response, making successful completion unreliable.
Required controls use native validation; the forgot-password journey is explicit, and a 404 shows “Page not found!” with a Back action.
Lighthouse measured FCP 4.5s and LCP 8.9s (performance 62); the separate trace still measured LCP 2.95s, showing material run/network sensitivity.
Mobile layout observation reports CLS 0 with no shifts; Lighthouse reports CLS 0.001.
The trace reports one 89.7ms long task and 39.7ms TBT; Lighthouse TBT is 140ms, acceptable despite slow network/LCP.
The HAR shows vid30s.com -> xpvid.cc -> vidoy.com -> vidoy.asia plus four parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and 1,007,587 transferred bytes.
Lighthouse estimates 23,270 of 27,543 bytes of Turbo JavaScript are unused (84.5%), with about 150ms LCP savings.
axe passes labels, link names, button names, image alt, heading order and main landmarks; the image has meaningful alt text.
axe and Lighthouse both report the Login control at 3:1 instead of the required 4.5:1 for normal-size text.
The focus probe finds multiple buttons with outline none and no replacement; axe reports the complementary aside nested inside another landmark.
Screenshots show start-aligned text, bounded line lengths, readable spacing and no clipping on desktop/mobile/legal templates.
The viewport meta includes maximum-scale=1; axe marks this as a critical violation even though 360px reflow itself has no overflow.
Lighthouse recorded Uncaught TurnstileError 110200 from challenges.cloudflare.com during load.
The image probe reports a 1250px PNG rendered at 178px, no srcset, and no height attribute.
Lighthouse reports cache-control:no-store with cookie modification and a live Turnstile MediaStreamTrack as actionable BFCache blockers.
DOM captures show the Terms page uses “Vidoy - Make money by sharing video” and “Login or create your Vidoy creator account,” identical to the landing page.
Links use real href values, viewport metadata exists, robots allows general crawling, and the discoverability probe recovers 98% of content without JS.
No canonical link is present, sitemap.xml returns 404, and the requested host traverses three other domains before the final page; robots otherwise allows search.
The recon probe finds zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite a public branded service landing page.
HTTPS is used, but the header probe finds no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
The network evidence finds eight third-party origins and loads openfpcdn.io/fingerprintjs before any user action; 19 of 20 requests are classified cross-origin from the requested host.
The auth DOM exposes username/password forms, while scripts and probes show no WebAuthn/passkey path; this is directly relevant to an account dashboard.
The response lacks HSTS, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; no CSP is available for Trusted Types or script restriction.
Raw server HTML contains 98% of rendered content, including title, H1 and meta description; crawler view remains complete without JavaScript.
Login/Register tab toggling preserves a stable 143-element DOM and the active register form remains a visible 380x528 grid.
The manifest has display: standalone and start_url /overview, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returns an empty list.
The representative unknown route returns a purpose-built error screen with a clear Back recovery action instead of a blank shell.
html lang=en is correct, but dir is absent, no logical CSS property was found, and the probe counts 12 physical left/right rules.

paths.description: Public landing and primary login/register journey; represents the acquisition and authentication surface.
Registration tab and client-side form state; represents account creation. Submission was not completed because it would create a real account, but the loaded anti-bot dependency was inspected.
Terms page; represents the long-form legal/content template.
Unknown route; represents HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: The viewport disables user zoom
findings.evidence: The viewport meta includes maximum-scale=1; axe marks this as a critical violation even though 360px reflow itself has no overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and any user-scalable restriction; retain width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

findings.summary: Several controls have no visible keyboard focus and some targets are only 16px high
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline none and no focus box-shadow for the auth tabs, submit button, eye button and Create account action; several footer/action links measure 16px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment and expand pointer target hit areas to at least 44px without changing visual density.

findings.summary: The registration dependency throws during the primary account-creation journey
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured an uncaught Cloudflare Turnstile Error 110200 while the registration form depends on cf-turnstile-response, making successful completion unreliable.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the Turnstile site/domain configuration, catch and explain challenge failures, and offer a retry path that preserves entered data.

findings.summary: Cold-load Largest Contentful Paint is slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 4.5s and LCP 8.9s (performance 62); the separate trace still measured LCP 2.95s, showing material run/network sensitivity.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect latency, prioritize the actual LCP content, and reduce blocking CSS and oversized image transfer.

findings.summary: Four redirects and multiple blocking styles delay useful content
findings.evidence: The HAR shows vid30s.com -> xpvid.cc -> vidoy.com -> vidoy.asia plus four parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and 1,007,587 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the canonical origin directly, collapse redirects, inline only critical CSS, and defer/split non-critical styles.

findings.summary: Primary action text does not meet minimum contrast
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse both report the Login control at 3:1 instead of the required 4.5:1 for normal-size text.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the accent behind white text or use a dark foreground while preserving clear hover, active and disabled states.

findings.summary: Core transport security headers are absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but the header probe finds no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, strict referrer policy, and least-privilege permissions policy.

findings.summary: The login page loads a fingerprinting library and a broad third-party footprint by default
findings.evidence: The network evidence finds eight third-party origins and loads openfpcdn.io/fingerprintjs before any user action; 19 of 20 requests are classified cross-origin from the requested host.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove covert fingerprinting unless strictly necessary and disclosed; gate non-essential third parties behind purpose-specific user action and minimize origins.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are not configured
findings.evidence: The response lacks HSTS, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; no CSP is available for Trusted Types or script restriction.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy the defense-in-depth policy set and test it in report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.summary: A single oversized legacy image dominates page weight
findings.evidence: The 862,424-byte hero PNG is 85.6% of transferred bytes and is rendered at only 178px without responsive alternatives.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants sized for actual slots and select them with picture/srcset/sizes.

findings.summary: Third-party and media cost is disproportionate for a simple auth landing page
findings.evidence: The HAR totals about 1.01MB across 20 requests, including an 862KB PNG and requests to eight third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a landing-page byte/origin budget, self-host critical assets, compress the hero, and defer non-essential third parties.

findings.summary: Hard-coded dark theme ignores a light system preference
findings.evidence: The light-preference screenshot is pixel-identical to the default dark page, and :root declares only color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light and dark support in early metadata and root CSS, then use preference-driven tokens or light-dark().

findings.summary: Contrast preference is not honoured and the primary button is below WCAG AA
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast screenshot is unchanged; axe reports white on #fb5d80 at 3:1 for the Login button.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise primary-control contrast to at least 4.5:1 and reinforce subtle borders/text under prefers-contrast: more or forced colors.

findings.summary: Most of the Turbo module is unused on the landing page
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 23,270 of 27,543 bytes of Turbo JavaScript are unused (84.5%), with about 150ms LCP savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Load Turbo only on routes that benefit from it or replace the landing-page behavior with a smaller route-specific module.

findings.summary: Focus styling and landmark nesting weaken keyboard and assistive-tech navigation
findings.evidence: The focus probe finds multiple buttons with outline none and no replacement; axe reports the complementary aside nested inside another landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Use explicit :focus-visible styles and simplify the auth card to a section or top-level complementary landmark as appropriate.

findings.summary: The page throws an uncaught Turnstile exception
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded Uncaught TurnstileError 110200 from challenges.cloudflare.com during load.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the Turnstile origin configuration and handle initialization errors without uncaught exceptions.

findings.summary: The hero image is oversized and incompletely dimensioned
findings.evidence: The image probe reports a 1250px PNG rendered at 178px, no srcset, and no height attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources with srcset/sizes and explicit intrinsic width and height.

findings.summary: Distinct pages reuse the login page title and description
findings.evidence: DOM captures show the Terms page uses “Vidoy - Make money by sharing video” and “Login or create your Vidoy creator account,” identical to the landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate route-specific titles and descriptions, such as “Terms of Service | Vidoy,” matching each page’s visible purpose.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete across a multi-domain redirect chain
findings.evidence: No canonical link is present, sitemap.xml returns 404, and the requested host traverses three other domains before the final page; robots otherwise allows search.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose one canonical public origin, redirect to it in one hop, emit canonical links, and publish a consistent sitemap.

findings.summary: Authentication offers passwords only and no phishing-resistant option
findings.evidence: The auth DOM exposes username/password forms, while scripts and probes show no WebAuthn/passkey path; this is directly relevant to an account dashboard.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey authentication and registration alongside existing recovery, using native WebAuthn browser APIs and vetted server verification.

findings.summary: The app advertises installability but has no service worker or offline fallback
findings.evidence: The manifest has display: standalone and start_url /overview, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returns an empty list.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a scoped service worker with network-first navigation and an intentional offline fallback, or stop advertising standalone app behavior.

findings.summary: The layout is not prepared for bidirectional or alternate writing modes
findings.evidence: html lang=en is correct, but dir is absent, no logical CSS property was found, and the probe counts 12 physical left/right rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an appropriate direction strategy and replace physical spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties.

findings.summary: Public account terms do not expose key user-control paths
findings.evidence: The audited public surfaces provide Terms, support and abuse email links but no visible privacy notice, account-deletion route, cancellation flow, or passkey reauthentication path.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish privacy/data-rights information and make account deletion, payout dispute, cancellation, and sensitive-action reauthentication paths easy to find.

findings.summary: Default-load work includes avoidable fingerprinting, challenge and redirect overhead
findings.evidence: The initial page performs four redirects and loads FingerprintJS and Turnstile before the user begins registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Land directly on the canonical page and defer security/identity scripts until the corresponding form or action is actually used.

findings.summary: Route and tab changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: DOM/script inspection finds Turbo and class-based tab swapping but no startViewTransition call, @view-transition rule, or view-transition-name.
findings.suggestedFix: Layer same-document and cross-document View Transitions onto tab and Turbo navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Reusable auth components rely only on viewport breakpoints
findings.evidence: The CSS probe finds no @container rules; the auth card is adapted exclusively with max/min-width media queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable shells a containment context and adapt internal layout with size-aware container queries.

findings.summary: The page is ineligible for BFCache under common navigation conditions
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports cache-control:no-store with cookie modification and a live Turnstile MediaStreamTrack as actionable BFCache blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Limit no-store to genuinely sensitive responses and tear down challenge media resources before pagehide where possible.

findings.summary: The public organization landing page has no social or structured metadata
findings.evidence: The recon probe finds zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite a public branded service landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter preview fields and Organization/WebSite JSON-LD that match visible content.
